_about: Seed relations for the aliveness ontology (#6720). Every edge starts as scholarly background (claude-opus-5-5) with the one-line `claim` below; edges.mjs then looks for pages that name both ends and a judge keeps a passage only if it STATES the relation. Types: translates (a translator's or tradition's rendering of the same concept), analogue (a cross-tradition parallel; never a merge), descends (`from` is a later development of `to`), belongs (`from` is a part or teaching of doctrine `to`), cultivates (practice `from` cultivates, conserves or produces `to`), opposes (`from` is set against `to`). Optional `cue` overrides the search phrases for one end.

edges.claim: Latin spiritus renders Greek pneuma.
The Septuagint renders Hebrew ruach as pneuma.
Arabic rūḥ and Hebrew ruach are cognate words for breath and spirit.
Arabic medical writers used rūḥ for the Galenic pneuma.
Spiritus vitalis renders Galen's pneuma zōtikon.
Spiritus animalis renders Galen's pneuma psychikon.
Anima mundi renders the Timaeus's psychē of the cosmos.
Tibetan bcud len translates Sanskrit rasāyana.
Tibetan rlung renders Sanskrit prāṇa and vāyu.
The breath of life of Genesis 2:7 (neshamah) is a near-synonym of ruach in the Hebrew Bible.
Qi and pneuma are both breath that becomes the stuff of life; comparativists pair them, the traditions did not.
Qi and prāṇa are both breath-energies moving through channels; the pairing is comparative.
The inner heat of tummo and the innate heat of Greek medicine are both a vital fire in the trunk; the pairing is comparative.
Chinese and Western alchemy each sought an elixir of long life; contact between them is debated.
Indian rasāyana and the Arabic-Latin elixir both promise rejuvenation by a prepared medicine.
Kami of a place and the Roman genius loci are both resident spirits of a site; the pairing is comparative.
Tibetan lords of the soil and the Roman genius loci are both owners of a place; the pairing is comparative.
Anthropologists from Marett to Mauss grouped mana, manitou and orenda as one category of impersonal power.
Kāyakalpa is a rasāyana regimen.
The Galenic vital spirits are a specification of spiritus.
Ficino's spiritus mundi extends the body's spirit to the cosmos.
Ficino's spirit of the world is the vehicle of the world soul.
Lévi's astral light restates the Renaissance spirit of the world.
Lévi identified the astral light with the magnetic fluid of the mesmerists.
Galvani's animal electricity took over the role of the animal spirits in the nerves.
Reichenbach's Od was proposed as the real agent behind mesmeric effects.
Renaissance natural magic works through the sympathies of things.
The weapon salve was defended as a cure by sympathy.
Paracelsian defenders explained the weapon salve by the mumia in the blood on the weapon.
Mesmer's magnetic medicine continues the 17th-century magnetic cure of wounds.
Mesmer's universal fluid restates cosmic sympathy as a physical medium.
Van Helmont reworked Paracelsian chemistry and the archeus.
Stahl's soul-directed physiology follows van Helmont's archeus.
Montpellier vitalism grew from Stahl's animism while removing the rational soul.
Barthez's vital principle is a secularised successor of the archeus.
German Lebenskraft physiology took up the Montpellier vital principle.
Bergson's élan vital is the last major restatement of vitalism.
Aristotle defines the soul as the first entelechy of a natural body.
Driesch revived Aristotle's entelechy as the agent of neo-vitalism.
Cudworth's plastic nature restates the Stoic and Platonic seminal reasons.
Cudworth's plastic nature is a subordinate instrument of the world soul or of God.
Blumenbach's formative drive replaces the older vis plastica.
The Stoic seminal reasons are carried in the divine pneuma.
The world soul is a Platonic teaching (Timaeus).
Schelling's Von der Weltseele (1798) revives the world soul.
Modern panpsychism descends from Renaissance world-soul doctrines (Patrizi).
The radical moisture was posited as the fuel of the innate heat.
Medieval and early modern programmes of prolonging life aimed to conserve the radical moisture.
Cornaro's sober life is an extreme form of the Galenic regimen of diet.
Francis Bacon and later writers on long life cite Cornaro.
Hufeland's Makrobiotik belongs to the line of Bacon's Historia vitae et mortis.
Hufeland cites Cornaro as an example of long life through moderation.
Hufeland's art of long life is the husbanding of the Lebenskraft.
Latin elixir lore merged with Rupescissa's quintessence.
Potable gold is one form of the elixir of life.
The universal medicine is the elixir as cure for all disease.
Aqua vitae is the distilled spirit from which Rupescissa drew the quintessence.
Inner alchemy took its vocabulary from laboratory (external) alchemy.
Spagyric pharmacy separates the quintessence or virtue from matter.
Ficino justified talismans with the Hermetic account of ensouled statues.
The golem legend repeats the forming of Adam from earth and his animation.
The homunculus recipe applies putrefactive generation to human seed.
Pneuma is the active principle of Stoic physics.
Cosmic sympathy is a Stoic teaching.
Seminal reasons are a Stoic teaching.
Plotinus adopted cosmic sympathy.
Ficino's spirit of the world belongs to his Platonism.
The ensouled statues are described in the Hermetic Asclepius.
The correspondence of microcosm and macrocosm is central to Hermetic and Paracelsian thought.
Paracelsus built medicine on the microcosm.
The archeus is a Paracelsian concept.
Van Helmont made the archeus the governor of each organ.
Mumia is a Paracelsian concept.
The natural balsam is a Paracelsian concept.
The elemental beings come from Paracelsus's Liber de nymphis.
The homunculus recipe is in the Paracelsian De natura rerum.
Spagyric pharmacy is Paracelsian.
The weapon salve was attributed to Paracelsus and defended by Paracelsians.
Vital spirits are one of Galen's three spirits.
Animal spirits are one of Galen's three spirits.
Innate heat is central to Galenic physiology.
Radical moisture belongs to Arabic-Latin Galenism.
The six non-naturals are Galenic.
Gerocomia is a branch of Galenic hygiene.
The vegetative soul is the lowest power of Aristotle's psychē.
Plastic nature is Cudworth's.
The vital principle is the Montpellier school's.
Montpellier is the paradigm school of vitalism.
Lebenskraft is the central concept of German vitalism.
The élan vital is the core of Creative Evolution.
The formative drive was a vitalist force.
Qi cultivation is central to Daoist practice.
Essence is one of the Daoist three treasures.
Transcendence is the Daoist goal.
Prāṇa is a principle of Āyurveda and yoga.
Ojas is an Āyurvedic concept.
Rasāyana is a branch of Āyurveda.
Kuṇḍalinī is raised in haṭha yoga.
Prāṇāyāma is a haṭha yoga practice.
Wind is one of the three humours of Tibetan medicine.
Rejuvenation (bcud len) is a branch of the Four Tantras.

Place spirits are classed under animism by Tylor and his successors.

Breath retention wakes kuṇḍalinī.
Tummo works by drawing the winds into the central channel.
Daoyin guides qi.
Embryonic breathing holds and circulates qi.
Inner alchemy refines essence into qi.
Inner alchemy aims at transcendence.
The cinnabar elixir was taken for immortality.
Avoiding grains was a step toward transcendence.
Nourishing life aims at a long life.
Nourishing life conserves qi.
Rasāyana is rejuvenation therapy.
Rasāyana increases ojas.
Kāyakalpa renews the body.
Essence extraction restores the body.
The elixir was taken to lengthen life.
The elixir was said to restore youth.
Potable gold was sold to preserve health and lengthen life.
The universal medicine was said to restore youth.
Rupescissa's quintessence preserves the body from corruption.
Aqua vitae was praised as a preserver of youth and life.
Regimen keeps the innate heat in balance.
Air, food and the passions govern the spirits.
Cornaro's sober life was a recipe for a long life.

The programme of prolonging life aims at longevity.

Spagyric balsams strengthen the body's natural balsam.

Plant palingenesis was read as an image of resurrection.
Vitalism defined itself against mechanism.

Stahl argued against the mechanist physiology of Hoffmann.

An automaton moves without a breath of life.

Long life defers death.

Alchemists and Paracelsians spoke of metallic seeds growing in the earth.
Metals that grow are not dead matter.
